request.message: My NakhlaID account shows NID-423 and has locked three times today without a known cause. I already checked saved passwords on my devices and found none. Please prepare a ticket.

response.reply:
Five failed sign-ins within 15 minutes lock the account for 30 minutes and show error NID-423. Three or more lockouts in one day without a known cause are treated as a possible password-guessing attack and must be reported to Security Operations with category 'security' and priority P2. [SP-001] [KB-006]
Review this exact ticket draft, then approve or reject it.
